children.topic: How to study with this library
Open a year, then a course
children.note: Each course bubble is a door: tap its small arrow to open the course map. Back brings you here.

children.topic: Tap + on a topic to see its key facts
children.note: Topics open to 5–8 facts. The fact is in the note (tap the bubble, then the note icon).

children.topic: Study turns facts into flashcards
children.note: Tap Study at the bottom of any map. Manas shows each card again just before you would forget it (spaced repetition).

children.topic: Quiz me gives ten quick questions
children.note: Multiple choice from the same course. Missed questions come back in your flashcards.

children.topic: Search finds any fact in any course
children.note: Use the search box on the home screen.

nodeData.note: A study library for the six-year MBChB as taught at the University of Nairobi (course list from the UoN programme page). Key facts are written for revision and were reviewed for accuracy, but this is a study aid: confirm clinical decisions with your lecturers, the current Kenya MoH guidelines and the Kenya Essential Medicines List.
